docs.title: Projects and files
docs.html: Select a file in the project tree to edit it. Use + File to add a file and its delete button to remove it.

docs.title: Compiler versions
docs.html: Use the version selector to choose a supported release, prerelease, or Nightly. Switching versions reloads the page and keeps your project.

docs.title: Compiler settings
docs.html: Edit tsconfig.json to choose compiler options and project files. Use completion and hover for option names and descriptions.

docs.title: Package types
docs.html: Types for imported packages are downloaded automatically. Disable this in Settings, or use typeAcquisition in tsconfig.json to include or exclude packages.

docs.title: Editor navigation
docs.html: Use F12 to go to a definition. The back arrow returns from library files to your project. Place // ^? beneath an expression to display its type.

docs.title: Emit and Run
docs.html: View generated JavaScript and declarations under Emit. Run executes your project and shows console output; it requires CommonJS-compatible output.

docs.title: Examples
docs.html: Choose an example from Examples to replace the current project. You will be asked to confirm first.

docs.title: Saving and sharing
docs.html: Your project is saved in this browser automatically. Copy the page URL to share it when automatic URL updates are enabled in Settings.

docs.title: Settings
docs.html: Open Settings to adjust the theme, font, editor preferences, URL updates, and automatic package types.
